subject: FW: CrossBeam connector MSA & SOW — redlines and procurement questions
messages:
From: Rina Shah <rina@crossbeam.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@crossbeam.io, procurement@crossbeam.io
Date: 2026-12-01T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: CrossBeam – Redwood Connector MSA & SOW (redlines)

Marcus —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached are CrossBeam's redlines to the MSA and the initial SOW for the connector project. Our legal team organized the changes into the doc (see CrossBeam_MSA_v3_redlines.docx) and the SOW highlights the implementation milestones and billing schedule (CrossBeam_SOW_v1.pdf).

High-level asks from our side:
- Standard indemnity and a limitation of liability tied to the fees (we've proposed 2x fees).
- Data processing and residency: we want explicit language about handling PII and an option for certain datasets to remain within the EU (we'll flag which ones later).
- Insurance and security evidence: please share SOC 2 Type II report and encryption/KMS details.
- Procurement: do you accept PO+Net30? Are there any minimum committed capacity or SKU requirements for the connector?

Can you confirm who on your side will lead the security evidence and procurement coordination? We're hoping to close commercials + DocuSign within two weeks if possible.

Thanks,
Rina Shah
Head of Strategic Alliances | CrossBeam
Rina Shah (she/her)
Attachments: CrossBeam_MSA_v3_redlines.docx (word), CrossBeam_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rina Shah <rina@crossbeam.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CrossBeam – Redwood Connector MSA & SOW (redlines)

Rina — thanks for sending these over and for the clear redlines. Looping in Lauren (sales ops) and Grace (security) so we can coordinate legal and procurement responses.

Quick read / our counterpoints at a glance:
- Limitation of liability: we can accept a monetary cap but propose 3x fees or $2M floor for strategic partners; we should avoid an open-ended multiple tied to historical spend.
- Indemnity: we can carve out gross negligence and will push for mutual indemnities where appropriate.
- Data residency: we support region-specific controls. For the connector, standard deployment will be US, but we can offer EU-restricted hosting for an add-on. Need to confirm which datasets CrossBeam needs in-EU.
- Security evidence: Grace will share SOC 2 Type II and our KMS integration notes. We do not use customer-side HSM by default; we support customer KMS with BYOK on Dedicated/Private plans.
- Procurement: we accept PO+Net30 for established partners, no minimum committed capacity for the connector (unless you want a reserved throughput option).

Attached is our baseline counter-MSA (RBW_CrossBeam_Counter_MSAv1.docx) with line-by-line responses. Key asks for you: confirm whether CrossBeam can accept the indemnity cap adjustment and allow for our standard data processing addendum (DPA) with the EU-hosting addendum if needed.

Proposed next steps:
1) Grace to send SOC 2 & KMS notes (end of day 12/2).
2) Internal alignment on commercial cap (Lauren to confirm acceptable cap ranges).
3) Exchange final redlines and create DocuSign packet (target 12/08).

I'll coordinate and follow up by tomorrow with specific language suggestions.

—Marcus
Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
Marcus Lin
Attachments: RBW_CrossBeam_Counter_MSAv1.docx (word)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CrossBeam – Redwood Connector MSA & SOW (internal alignment)

Team — quick internal thread so we keep action items tracked. I'm summarizing the redlines and where we should be firm vs flexible.

Summary of items we need decisions on:
- Indemnity / liability cap: CrossBeam asked for 2x fees; legal prefers 3x or $2M floor. Lauren, can you confirm whether Sales Ops is comfortable with a $2M floor + 3x fees for the first 12 months? If they want stickered pricing changes, that impacts our renewals math.
- Data residency: Grace, can you confirm the SOC 2 packet ETA? Also need a short blurb on our BYOK options for Dedicated/Private and whether a simple note in the SOW is sufficient or whether they require a KMS integration timeline.
- SOW milestones and payment schedule: CrossBeam's SOW proposes 40/60 split (implementation / go-live). I attached a proposed_payment_table.csv with an alternate 30/60/10 (kickoff / deliverable / warranty). Thoughts?
- Procurement terms: we can accept PO+Net30. Lauren please confirm whether finance needs an E-invoice workflow or specific remittance instructions for CrossBeam (they are enterprise-savvy but want PO).

Action owners: Grace — security evidence + short note on KMS (ETA EOD 12/3). Lauren — confirm acceptable liability cap and procurement flow (ETA 12/3 EOD). Priyom — product review on SOW deliverables (are the milestones feasible, ETA 12/4). I'll capture final counterpoints and send to Rina.

Keep replies short — we should avoid over-emailing the partner while we finalize.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Rina Shah <rina@crossbeam.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@crossbeam.io, procurement@crossbeam.io
Date: 2026-12-05T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CrossBeam – Redwood Connector MSA & SOW (redlines and procurement questions)

Thanks Marcus — and thanks everyone for the fast turnaround.

We reviewed your counter-MSA and the internal notes. We can agree in principle to the 3x cap if there is a $1.5M floor instead of $2M (our procurement prefers a lower floor due to order of magnitude for this project). We also accept a mutual indemnity carve-out for gross negligence.

Regarding data residency: CrossBeam will provide a dataset list within 48 hours of signature; for now we need contractual assurance we can request EU-hosted processing for specific datasets at no additional license fee (we understand hosting costs may apply). For KMS/BYOK: procurement noted that customer-side KMS will be required for EU-hosted data; please include a short KMS integration note in the SOW.

Procurement logistics: we will issue a PO upon execution and request Net30. I've attached a short procurement form to speed finance approvals. Also including a DocuSign powerlink for the final packet: https://docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456

If you can send a final MSA with the agreed cap and the DPA + EU addendum incorporated, we can route for signature by 12/08. Grace — if you can confirm SOC 2 & BYOK steps, we can mark security as satisfied. Lauren — procurement will ask for Redwood's remittance and W9 if we reach signature.

Next steps we propose:
- Marcus: prepare final MSA + DPA (include EU-hosting addendum + KMS note) — target 12/06 EOD.
- Grace: SOC 2 package + KMS integration summary — target 12/05 EOD (or ASAP).
- Lauren: remittance/W9 details to procurement — target 12/06.

Appreciate the teamwork — excited to get this into DocuSign and move to onboarding.

Best,
Rina
Head of Strategic Alliances | CrossBeam
Attachments: CrossBeam_procurement_form.pdf (pdf)
